english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, there arose a complaint against the Hebrews by the Hellenists, because their widows were neglected in the daily distribution.
chiru: Khalai a nikho hai khan akhaichawi hai jat kha hawng rawp shishit le roroia, Greek hai na, nikhonikho a nekleshak reshemna khan, amani mieirawng hai kha ruenda uh, tia Hebrew hai chung a ningnitna boi kha rurophong uh.

english: Then the twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, It is not desirable that we should leave the word of God and serve tables.
chiru: Khan tirtawn shawmlieidi kha na khaichawi hai kholok kha ruchun a ruti uh, Tirtawn kieini na Pathien chawng kha mathan a tebol chung ah nekleshak reshepna niboi pui u hi adik nimak.

english: Therefore, brethren, seek out from among you seven men of good reputation, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business;
chiru: Khajarkhan uliennai hai mahi chonmun hin a rashap pui rang, mi na kungichangna, Ratha Riethieng le shingna aship, ashing miring shiri nang kar ua tawk u tana kieini na madan u rang kanih.

english: but we will give ourselves continually to prayer and to the ministry of the word.
chiru: Inia kieini tu anih le chawngshemna a repeh u rang kanih.

english: And the saying pleased the whole multitude. And they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and the Holy Spirit, and Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas, a proselyte from Antioch,
chiru: Mahi chawng hi na mipui kha ningruminit pe a takashawn anieitak le Ratha Riethieng aship, Stephen, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, khan Jihudi ajir Antioch miring, Nicolas, amani hai hi rumadan uh.

english: whom they set before the apostles; and when they had prayed, they laid hands on them.
chiru: Amani kha tirtawn hai maikung a rumiding ua nikna runiei pe uh, khan amani chung a khut rutet pe uh.

english: Then the word of God spread, and the number of the disciples multiplied greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests were obedient to the faith.
chiru: Khan Pathien chawng kha rurajar a Jerusalem shung ah khaichawi hai jat kha ajeng a rupung joi. Khan thiempu hai kar a tampui na takashawn kha rushap u joi.

english: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.
chiru: Stephen na, takashawn le ranak ship a, miring hai kar a rekhekchon le jetna lienpui ruthaw.

english: Then there arose some from what is called the Synagogue of the Freedmen (Cyrenians, Alexandrians, and those from Cilicia and Asia), disputing with Stephen.
chiru: Khania Synagogue Moshok Miring hai iti ah put ah miring, Cyrene, Alexandria, khan Cilicia le Asia miring hai na Stephen le chawngrieshietna rumothoi uh.

english: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
chiru: Inia ama ruchawngna shingna le Ratha chung khan rumene ngam u mak.

english: Then they secretly induced men to say, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.
chiru: Khashole amani na miring eshen muruk a rurachak ua, Ama na Moses le khan Pathien mieshietna chawngiriei kha kejet uh, rumiti uh.

english: And they stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes; and they came upon him, seized him, and brought him to the council.
chiru: Amani na shierulien hai, danoja hai kha le roroia, mi hai kha rumarang uh. Khashole amani na jetboithieiboi a va uh, khan ama kha rushur ua Sanhedrin ah ruchawi uh.

english: They also set up false witnesses who said, This man does not cease to speak blasphemous words against this holy place and the law;
chiru: Amani na adik boi kungchangna hai kha rupek ua ruti uh, Mahi miringpa hi na riethiengmun le Dan irodoi pui mieshietna chawngriei kha bang mak.

english: for we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs which Moses delivered to us.
chiru: Ajarla ama na iriei kejet uh, makhala mahi Nazareth Jesu hi na hi mun hi mathang rangnih, khan kieini dieng inepek Moses shedan kha melet rangnih.

english: And all who sat in the council, looking steadfastly at him, saw his face as the face of an angel.
chiru: Khan Sanhedrin shung a rushuh miring kholok na ama kha ruenrep u phakhan, ama meh kha ravantir meh ang a rumuk uh.
